title: The daily board of one board day
description: site-data/boards/days/<board day>/daily.json, in version 1 of the RisingRepos data contract. The contract's README.md, in the RisingRepos repository at src/risingrepos/publishing/contract/, says how the files are laid out and how the contract changes. Every field is listed here and no other may appear. A field whose description starts with 'Untrusted' holds text a repository's owner wrote.

schema_version.description: The contract's version. It rises when a field is removed or changes what it holds.

board_day.description: The board day, as YYYY-MM-DD. The file's folder has the same name.

published_at.description: When this board day was first published, in UTC, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Publishing the board day again keeps it, so it says how old the board day is, not when the file was last written.

score_provisional.description: True while the score that ranked this board is provisional. The page then says so.

rows.description: The board, in rank order. An empty board has no rows.

rank.description: The row's place on the board: 1 for the first row, and one more for each row after it.

github_id.description: GitHub's numeric id for the repository. It stays the same when the repository is renamed or moves to another owner.

full_name.description: Untrusted: the owner chose it. The repository's owner and name, as owner/name, on the board day. The site links it to https://github.com/<full_name>. It holds only letters, digits, '-', '_', '.', and the one '/', so that address stays on GitHub.

description.description: Untrusted: the owner wrote it, and it can hold markup or an address. At most 350 characters: a longer one is cut to its first 349 and ends with '…'. Null when the repository has none, and never an empty string.

language.description: Untrusted: GitHub detects it from the owner's files, and the owner can override it. GitHub's name for the repository's main language. Null when GitHub names none, and never an empty string.

stars.description: The repository's star count on the board day.
